descriptionHtml:
Gigabyte B550M DS3H AC AMD AM4 Micro-ATX Motherboard with Wi-Fi & Bluetooth

Build a rock-solid, high-performance gaming platform or production workstation with the reliable Gigabyte B550M DS3H AC Micro-ATX Motherboard. Available at Turbo Computer, this feature-packed AMD AM4 socket motherboard fully unleashes the true potential of AMD Ryzen 5000 Series, 4000 G-Series, and 3000 Series processors. It stands as the ultimate price-to-performance hardware foundation for PC builders across Egypt who require advanced PCIe 4.0 speed, stable power delivery, and built-in wireless connectivity without overspending.

The Gigabyte B550M DS3H AC is engineered for top-tier efficiency, utilizing a robust 5+3 phases pure digital VRM solution with Low RDS(on) MOSFETs to guarantee smooth power under heavy loads. It features ultra-fast Dual NVMe PCIe 4.0/3.0 x4 M.2 slots for lightning-fast SSD storage tracking and an onboard dual-band AC wireless interface paired with Bluetooth for clean, cable-free setups. Enhanced with Realtek GbE LAN, RGB FUSION 2.0 support for customized lighting, and Smart Fan 5 cooling arrays, it provides the definitive entry into high-speed AM4 configurations.
